# Scaffold step — how to generate the Vite base files
#
# The files in src/components/ and src/lib/ are hand-written stubs (TODO instructions).
# The standard Vite + Tailwind base files are NOT committed here because they are
# generated by the scaffold command. Run this once to create them:
#
#   cd "D:\D Drive\Job Prep\portfolio"
#   npm create vite@latest . -- --template react
#       (if prompted that the dir is not empty, choose "Ignore files and continue")
#   npm install
#   npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite postcss autoprefixer
#
# After scaffolding, these files will exist (generated, not hand-written):
#   index.html
#   package.json
#   vite.config.js
#   postcss.config.js
#   src/main.jsx
#   src/App.jsx
#   src/index.css
#
# Then wire Tailwind:
#   - tailwind.config.js: set content paths to ["./index.html","./src/**/*.{js,jsx}"]
#   - src/index.css: add the Tailwind directives (@tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;)
#   - vite.config.js: add the @tailwindcss/vite plugin
#
# Keep this file as a reference for the scaffold step. Do not delete the hand-written stubs.
